scope: Two deterministic known-layout objectives; not success-rate or generalization evidence

protocol.fixed_rule: Predeclared structured color mapping/priority; does not parse natural language
protocol.gpt: Real subscription request; approve only an exact objective-compatible proposal; no retries/fallback
protocol.pairing: Full model plus qpos/qvel/ctrl/equalities/forces/solver warmstart/activation/mocap before planning
protocol.planning_clock: Physics advances while awaiting GPT; no manipulation before approval
protocol.execution_clock: Accelerated headless; wall time is not real-time throughput
protocol.timing: Execution simulation time, provider wall latency and headless execution wall time remain separate
protocol.controls: Identical physical controller and limits for both methods; additional independent 5 s hold
